changelog: Capture resilience against malformed input and database outages
HEP over TCP rejects declared lengths smaller than its header and closes the connection instead
HEPv3 rejects malformed or truncated chunks, while compressed payload expansion is capped at
changelog_es: Captura resistente a entradas adversariales y caídas de PostgreSQL
HEP sobre TCP rechaza longitudes menores al encabezado y cierra la conexión, evitando un ciclo
HEPv3 rechaza longitudes y chunks truncados; los payloads comprimidos se expanden con un límite
